summary: A theory that FITS the data well but only by introducing a free fudge parameter tuned to fit, with no physical meaning or provenance. It must be killed by the whitebox gate regardless of fit quality — OpenQG only considers real whitebox theories with meaningful parameters.

pillars.name: free-knob-fit
pillars.claim: An adjustable coefficient is tuned to fit the observed H0 and S8 values.
pillars.mechanism: free parameter tuned to fit data
assumptions: no derivation; the coefficient is fit, not derived
falsifiers: any held-out observable the knob was not fit to

notes: Whitebox-veto decoy: fits well but is gray-box (a free fudge parameter with no provenance + 'tuned to fit' language). Dies on the GrayBox critic, not on physics — proving the whitebox gate works.
